verdict.rationale: Xero ships a built-in AI assistant called JAX that can reconcile bank transactions and create/edit/send invoices via plain-language commands, and AI also auto-extracts bill details, showing delegated task execution inside the product itself. However, evidence is limited to marketing copy for two specific workflows (reconciliation, invoicing) with no independent/hands-on corroboration of broader task delegation or general-purpose assistant capabilities. Missing for 10: independent verification of JAX's real-world performance, evidence of broader delegation beyond invoicing/reconciliation, and details on assistant scope/limits.
